name: Street Furniture Kit · Round 1
domainSummary: A reusable civic kit with one simple lamp, one bench, exactly two bollards, one compact waste bin, one low planter, consistent pedestrian scale, and orderly spacing on a shared paving plate.
evidenceBoundary: Keep the kit neutral and unowned. Do not imply municipality, district, accessibility certification, active lighting, occupancy, planting species, or a real product family.

researchSources.title: Career World ambient expansion inventory
researchSources.use: Accepted street-furniture-kit role and canonical component list.

researchSources.title: Tournament production ledger
researchSources.use: Exact kit count, shared-base identity, and map-scale boundary.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Canonical Production
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into its clearest production-ready map prop; emphasize single restrained street lamp
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested in its most resolved reusable form. This version emphasizes single restrained street lamp.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Silhouette Contrast
assets.controlledVariable: push the outer contour and negative spaces for instant recognition at map scale; emphasize single pedestrian bench
assets.thesis: A distinct silhouette tests recognition without labels or color. This version emphasizes single pedestrian bench.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Weighted Asymmetry
assets.controlledVariable: shift the dominant mass off-center while preserving the asset's practical balance; emphasize exact pair of bollards
assets.thesis: Controlled asymmetry creates identity without sacrificing function. This version emphasizes exact pair of bollards.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Functional Exposure
assets.controlledVariable: make the asset's defining working parts structurally legible without diagrams; emphasize compact bin and low planter
assets.thesis: Exposed function tests whether the object reads through construction rather than decoration. This version emphasizes compact bin and low planter.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Rugged Structure
assets.controlledVariable: strengthen load-bearing edges, joints, guards, and contact points; emphasize modular spacing on shared paving plate
assets.thesis: Rugged construction tests a durable working-world interpretation. This version emphasizes modular spacing on shared paving plate.
assets.businessCue: modular spacing on shared paving plate

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Modular Rhythm
assets.controlledVariable: organize repeated functional elements into a clear unequal rhythm on one coherent object or shared base; emphasize single restrained street lamp
assets.thesis: A modular cadence tests reuse and system belonging. This version emphasizes single restrained street lamp.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Low Profile
assets.controlledVariable: compress height and emphasize a long stable footprint while retaining every defining feature; emphasize single pedestrian bench
assets.thesis: A low profile tests legibility in dense map placement. This version emphasizes single pedestrian bench.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Vertical Accent
assets.controlledVariable: give one legitimate functional element a taller focal role while keeping the overall prop subordinate to buildings; emphasize exact pair of bollards
assets.thesis: A vertical accent tests landmark readability without turning the prop into architecture. This version emphasizes exact pair of bollards.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the asset to the smallest complete form that preserves its exact identity and component count; emphasize compact bin and low planter
assets.thesis: The primitive reveals which cues are essential. This version emphasizes compact bin and low planter.

assets.name: Street Furniture Kit · Ambient Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance silhouette, function, construction, modular detail, and map-scale restraint in one production-ready prop; emphasize modular spacing on shared paving plate
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests the complete ambient identity for repeated world use. This version emphasizes modular spacing on shared paving plate.
assets.businessCue: modular spacing on shared paving plate
